modules.module_title: Carryout safety procedures as per safety rules

pcs.pc_description: follow Oil Industry Safety Directorate (OISD) standards related to firefighting equipment and appliances in oil and gas industry
define Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) policies
prepare and maintain checklist to monitor safety regulations in and around oil and gas installations
check proper positioning and accessibility of fire extinguishers and first aid boxes
check for proper signs related to safety, emergency pathway and exit availability
maintain fire safety equipment i.e. fire extinguishers, fire alarms, sprinkler, smoke detectors, fire hose etc to ensure readiness during emergency
inspect oil and gas installations and surrounding area for any hazard to prevent harm to people, property and environment
check for flammable materials and initiate necessary safety measures
record near-miss events and take preventive measures
coordinate with operation and maintenance team for fire safety awareness programs and conduct safety drills at workplace
demonstrate first aid medical treatment procedure
demonstrate actions to be taken in case of fire
prepare and maintain daily inspection report and submit it to the reporting authority responsible for fire safety

pcs.pc_description: identify the ignition source such as flame, spark, static electricity, heat source etc.
classify fire according to standard class of fire i.e. class A, B, C, D & E
select the type of fire extinguishers to be used according to the class of fire
use various PPEs applicable during firefighting
adopt suitable firefighting method according to class of fire and firefighting equipment
operate fire extinguishers using appropriate method to extinguish fire
maintain firefighting equipment as per maintenance check list
respond to fire caused due to oil spills or gas leakage with the appropriate fire extinguishing method
check for open or damage valves in case of fire due to oil spills or gas leakage
carryout first aid measures in case of inhalation of toxic gas
report the problem to his reporting authority in case of emergency situations
inform the fire safety team/in charge in case the situation is out of control
